items.question: Is this export the whole vRO estate? If not, what is missing, and how many vRO nodes or clusters does the estate run on?
items.why: Every count in Assess and Brief is only as complete as the export. A partial export hides callers and callees.

items.question: What starts these workflows from outside vRO? Two ways to answer, and they can be combined: put the vRA content export (a .vra-ng from Build Tools) in the export folder, and the tool reads its catalog items, cloud templates and event broker subscriptions; and list in your-input/entry-points.yaml whatever that export does not hold, or everything if there is no export: vRO scheduled tasks and policies, the ITSM (for example ServiceNow), and scripts calling the vRO REST API. Set complete: true there once the list is whole.
items.why: None of these are in a vRO package. Without them every workflow nobody calls in the export looks like an entry point or dead code, and the two cannot be told apart.
read_by: brief: retire pass, entry points, rebuild outcome

items.why: A wave that writes to a target cannot be verified without somewhere safe to write. Read-only waves can go first either way.

items.question: If vRA starts any of these workflows: will it stay as the front end, with its catalog items and subscriptions calling Kestra, or be replaced, with Kestra Apps and flows taking over its catalog items, cloud templates and subscriptions? Answer keep, replace, or replace with a bridge until then (vRA's subscriptions call Kestra through webhooks while the Apps and flows are built, then vRA is switched off).
items.why: The trigger plan differs: kept, every subscription calls a Kestra webhook (and a blocking one waits for the result); replaced, each catalog item becomes a Kestra App and each cloud template a flow whose steps are the old lifecycle events; replaced with a bridge, the converted flows run behind webhooks first and vRA goes once the replacement is ready. Unanswered, the brief shows both.
read_by: brief: trigger plan, wave entry criteria
items.plain: Will vRA stay as the front end and call Kestra, or will Kestra replace it? (keep, replace, or replace with a bridge until then)
